subject: See a shared repair-stage board
preview_text: Inspect how Repairboard presents each repair’s current stage.
body:
Repairboard puts the current stage of each repair on a shared board, giving the shop and its customers a clear place to inspect status.

A shop can share a read-only status link with a customer. The customer can view the repair’s status through that link without gaining editing access to the board.

The sample repair board lets you inspect how current stages are presented on the shared board. It does not establish how Repairboard would fit an existing process or whether updates require separate entry.

For now, it offers one useful test: whether this way of presenting repair stages suits how you want customers to inspect status.
